**Finding: compliant** (INSURANCE — Vendor insurance)

Section 18 of the Cobalt agreement already sits at our **preferred** position:

| Preferred element | Document |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M per occurrence | § 18.1 — "at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence" |
| CGL USD 2M aggregate | § 18.1 — "USD 2,000,000 aggregate" |
| E&O USD 2M | § 18.1 — "professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000" |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M where Customer Data processed | § 18.1 — USD 5,000,000, stated unconditionally |
| Workers' comp as required by law | § 18.1 — express |
| Certificates on request | § 18.2 — "On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance" |

Additional terms run in our favour and were left untouched: coverage for the term plus one year, employer's liability of USD 1M, primary-coverage wording, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and the confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. No redline proposed.
